reason: Wrong direction for this category (docs readable, re-opened 2026-09-25 in headless Chromium): Zid Docs (https://docs.zid.sa/) describe partner apps that 'enhance the functionality of online stores' and call the Merchant APIs (Account, Orders, Reverse Orders, Abandoned Carts, Products, Inventories, Shipping, Marketing, Customers, Store Settings) with per-merchant OAuth. Zid is a store platform, so these read and manage a merchant's own store; there is no supplier catalogue to buy from, no shipping quote from a supplier and no create_order that buys from a supplier, which is what this category's verbs describe. Its 'custom MCP server' only answers questions about the documentation. An adapter belongs with the sales channels.
